summary: Frontend-only regression for Poly World Iteration 17 (Move-Building rewrite + 3D Factory + house-footprint scale) at 390x844. 7/8 review items PASS, 1 item PARTIAL/FAIL. VERIFIED: (1) City Screen reached (menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game -> Skip -> capital tap 195,420 -> enter-city -> city-screen). (2) Material Factory placed via press-drag on place-layer with GREEN ghost. It renders as a RAISED 3D iso box, confirmed by three SVG polygons at CityMap.tsx:230-234: fill='#AEB6BE' (top/roof), '#6E747B' (left face), '#565C63' (right face) — no more flat diamond. White factory icon overlays at (mid.y - FACTORY_H - 12). (3) MOVE mode wiring works: city-edit -> edit-menu (testID edit-menu) -> edit-move mounts move-layer (testID move-layer); edit label flips 'Edit'->'Done'. (4) MOVE press-and-drag PARTIALLY works: starting a drag on the BASE of the factory (below the 3D top face, e.g. y = press.center.y ≈ base of diamond) shows a green ghost, dispatches onMoveBuilding, and the 'Building moved' toast fires — visually confirmed factory relocated from (143,499) -> (65,434) -> (13,395). HOWEVER, starting a drag on the visible TOP FACE (the roof of the 3D box, where the white factory icon is drawn) produces NO ghost and NO move — see 'rca_of_issue' for the bug and fix. (5) Invalid drop: dragging the factory ghost over the citadel produces a RED ghost fill 'rgba(220,70,70,0.4)' and on release the factory stays put. (6) Edit toggle: while in move mode the Edit button shows 'Done'; tapping it removes move-layer and restores 'Edit'. (7) DEMOLISH regression: Edit -> edit-demolish -> tap factory -> 3D box (top polygon) removed and factory-<id> pressable disappears. (8) ROADS regression: city-roads draws stroke, Done persists 6 brown ('#8A7B5C') cells; edit-delete-road tints all 6 roads red and clicking removes one (6->5). (9) Exit unmounts city-screen; action-end-turn pressed 2x, HUD advances (T3 visible), no red-screen crash. React Native Web deprecation warnings still print (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode) — pre-existing.

ui_bugs.issue: Move-building hit-test misses the factory when the user presses on the visible top face (roof) of the elevated 3D box. buildingAt() projects the finger point onto the base grid plane (Y=0) but ignores the 32px FACTORY_H elevation, so touching the roof (or the white factory icon, which is drawn at mid.y - FACTORY_H - 12 = ~44px above the base) maps to an EMPTY cell above the footprint and returns null. Press-drag only works when the finger lands on the lower half of the box (near/below the base diamond). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/CityMap.tsx:150-159 (buildingAt) and :285-293 (icon draw at -topOff). Users will aim at the icon and the move will silently fail on real devices.

issues: The white factory icon sits ~44px above the base of the factory building. Combined with the hit-test bug above, this creates a visible/interactive mismatch: users will press where they SEE the factory (the icon on top of the 3D box), but the hit-test only responds to touches near the base diamond.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Make CityMap.buildingAt account for the factory's 3D elevation. Options: (a) in buildingAt, when no building is found at the projected cell (cx,cy), probe additional cells shifted upward by round(FACTORY_H/HH) rows (~3 cells for FACTORY_H=32, HH=10) — i.e., try (cx+k, cy+k) for k in 1..4 and return the first factory-typed building whose footprint contains that cell. (b) Or, for each building of type 'factory', extend its logical hit rectangle upward by FACTORY_H when testing. Also, in moveBegin/moveUpdate, if the finger started on a factory, keep tracking that same building even if the pointer drifts back and forth over the elevated top face. This will unblock users who tap the visible roof/icon.

(No fix required) Factory now renders as a proper isometric 3D box (roof + left + right faces + top-mounted icon) — visually confirmed. Places FREE as advertised, GREEN ghost during placement, RED ghost on invalid.
(No fix required) Edit menu, Move-layer mounting, Edit-label 'Edit'/'Done' toggle, Demolish, Roads draw+delete, Exit + End-Turn all behave correctly.
(Optional, non-blocking) Cleanup: hoist parent callbacks out of setStroke/setGhost/setMoveGhost updaters to eliminate the React-18 setState-in-render warning (carried over from iteration 15/16).
critical_code_review_comments: CityMap.tsx:150-159 buildingAt only inverts the iso projection to the Y=0 base plane. For elevated buildings (factory has visible geometry at y_screen - FACTORY_H), the visible top face maps to grid cells shifted by ~FACTORY_H/HH rows upward, so pressing the roof misses the building. This is the root cause of the failing Move test on the top face.

CityMap.tsx:285-293 the factory ICON is drawn at (mid.x - 12, mid.y - (FACTORY_H+12)) — i.e., ~44px above the base center. That maximizes the chance of a user tapping outside the base-plane hit-test region. Consider growing the buildingAt tolerance to at least cover the drawn icon area.

rca_of_issue:
BUG: MOVE BUILDING press-drag fails when the user presses on the visible TOP FACE (roof) of the 3D factory box.

Reproduction steps (390x844):
  1. Start a new single-player game and enter the capital.
  2. Buildings -> Factory -> press-drag on the map to place it (green ghost).
  3. Note the factory renders as a RAISED grey 3D box. The white factory icon sits at approximately mid.y - 44px, and the top-face polygon (SVG fill='#AEB6BE') is centered ~32px above the base diamond.
  4. Tap Edit -> Move Building. move-layer mounts, Edit label becomes 'Done'.
  5. Press-and-drag STARTING on the visible top-face / icon of the factory to an empty cell nearby.
  6. OBSERVED: no green ghost renders, on release nothing happens, no 'Building moved' toast. Factory does not relocate.
  7. Repeat step 5 but start the drag on the LOWER half of the factory (near the base diamond, roughly the bottom third of the visible box). OBSERVED: green ghost appears, factory relocates on release, toast fires. Move logic works — only the hit-test is off.

Root cause:
  CityMap.tsx buildingAt(px, py) (lines 150-159) inverts the isometric projection back to the Y=0 base grid plane:
    bx = (px - tx) / scale; by = (py - ty) / scale
    X = (bx - OX) / HW;    Y = (by - HH) / HH
    cx = floor((X+Y)/2);   cy = floor((Y-X)/2)
  Then it linearly scans buildings for one whose footprint contains (cx, cy). But the visible geometry of the factory is drawn at (base_y - FACTORY_H=32), i.e., a screen point on the roof/icon maps to a grid cell shifted by round(FACTORY_H/HH)=~3 cells UPWARD on the grid, which is OUTSIDE the factory's 2x2 base footprint. Therefore buildingAt returns null and moveBegin sets moveRef.current = null, so moveUpdate is a no-op and moveEnd never fires onMoveBuilding.

Suggested mitigation (any one is sufficient):
  A) In buildingAt, if no hit at (cx,cy), also probe (cx+k, cy+k) for k=1..ceil(FACTORY_H/HH)+1 (~4 iterations) and accept the first building with type==='factory' whose footprint contains that shifted cell. Keep the original probe first so non-elevated buildings continue to work.
  B) For each factory building, expand its logical hit rectangle upward by FACTORY_H/HH cells only when testing (i.e., check cx in [b.x, b.x+s) AND cy in [b.y - shift, b.y + s)).
  C) Instead of a per-frame projection, hit-test against the SVG element under the pointer (document.elementFromPoint on web, or a Pressable wrapper on the extruded box on native) — this is the most robust fix.

Everything else in Iteration 17 is behaving correctly: 3D factory rendering, place-layer drag, road-layer draw + delete, demolish, edit-menu, edit label toggle, invalid-drop red ghost, exit + end-turn.
